_schema: off-market-deal-finder class scoring v2.0. See references/pipeline-contract.md Section 11 for the band schema and references/scoring/shared_adjustments.json for multipliers, tiers, caps and suppressions. Weights sum to 100.

bands.reading: Lender has elected to sell; owner still controls the outcome and competitors keyed on NODs are arriving now.
bands.lever: Fast, respectful first touch: options, not price.

bands.reading: Publication is approaching; the owner knows the sale date and has stopped hoping it goes away.
bands.lever: Reinstatement math, short-pay or sale-before-sale timeline.

bands.reading: Cure deadline (sale minus 5 days) is weeks away; this is maximum urgency.
bands.lever: Certainty of close before the cure deadline; lender-consent paths.

bands.reading: Sale postponed (up to 180 days allowed); owner is negotiating or stalling.
bands.lever: Ask what the postponement is for; offer the alternative.

bands.reading: Washington's first recorded instrument is already the sale notice; cure runs to the 11th day before sale.
bands.lever: Immediate outreach; RCW 61.34 gate before any leaseback.

bands.reading: Lender substituted a foreclosure trustee; NOD typically follows within weeks.
bands.lever: Reach the owner before the NOD crowd; set a pre-NOD watch.

bands.reading: Resolution conference completed; the lender is clearing the last statutory step before recording the NOD.
bands.lever: Same as trustee appointment; re-score when NOD records.

bands.reading: Three years delinquent and published; the county has filed for judgment.
bands.lever: Payoff at closing is small relative to equity; simple sale.

bands.reading: Judgment entered; redemption period running; owner can still redeem by paying.
bands.lever: Redeem-and-sell structure; deadline math.

bands.reading: HOA or private lender suing to foreclose; 6-12 months to sheriff's sale.
bands.lever: Lien payoff and clean exit before judgment.

bands.reading: Stay lifted; foreclosure resumes where it left off.
bands.lever: Speed; the lender will not wait again.

bands.reading: Estate open; no statutory clock on the house, only on the estate.
bands.lever: Patient letter to the personal representative after 60-120 days.

factors.name: signal_stacking

bands.reading: Two independent records agree something is wrong.
bands.lever: Lead with the fact the owner already knows about.

bands.reading: Three independent records; distress is not an artifact of one dataset.
bands.lever: Multi-channel outreach is justified.

bands.reading: Converging distress across debt, estate, tax and condition.
bands.lever: Highest priority; personal visit if local.

modifiers.reading: Heirs facing a foreclosure clock they did not create.
Trustee substitution and OFAP certificate both recorded; NOD is imminent.

factors.notes: Assessor-derived facts (hold years, absentee, tax delinquency from the same roll) count once. Cap 20 after modifiers.

factors.name: equity

bands.reading: Owner can sell at a discount and still walk away whole.
bands.lever: Convenience and certainty; no price in first touch.

bands.reading: Comfortable equity; a fair discount is possible.
bands.lever: Net-sheet conversation.

bands.reading: Enough equity to close but little room for a deep discount.
bands.lever: Terms (speed, as-is) over price.

bands.reading: Thin; closing costs consume most of it.
bands.lever: Short-pay or lender-consent paths.

bands.reading: Lender controls the economics.
bands.lever: Route lender_counterparty if NOD present.

factors.notes: equity_cushion_pct = (RMV x neighborhood sales ratio - total liens incl. HECM, DOR deferral, judgments) / value. A stated sum owing on a Notice of Sale overrides the amortized estimate. Basis multiplier uses balance_basis.

bands.reading: Personal representative managing an asset nobody chose; liquidity needs.
bands.lever: Simplicity; stepped-up basis removes the tax lock.

bands.reading: Elderly owner; loan due on death or move-out; heirs must act within months.
bands.lever: Respectful, non-pressuring; coordinate with servicer timelines.

bands.reading: Senior/disabled owner deferring taxes; deferred balance due at sale.
bands.lever: Include deferral payoff in the net sheet; soft outreach only.

bands.reading: Remote owner of a local problem.
bands.lever: Mail then DNC-scrubbed call; offer to handle everything.

bands.reading: Absentee within Oregon/Washington.
bands.lever: Mail-first.

bands.reading: Local landlord or relative; weakest absentee tier.
bands.lever: Never a standalone lead.

bands.reading: Estate-planning stage ownership; successor trustee may prefer liquidity.
bands.lever: Trustee letter.

bands.reading: Small landlord running repeat evictions under Portland's rules; fatigue.
bands.lever: Regulatory-fatigue angle; buy with tenants in place.

bands.reading: Divorce usually forces sale or buyout within a year.
bands.lever: Neutral, both-parties certainty pitch.

bands.reading: Owner lives there; motivation must come from another family.
bands.lever: Only with a hard trigger.

bands.reading: City case with escalating monthly fees and lien exposure.
bands.lever: As-is purchase ends the bleeding.

bands.reading: No one receiving mail; carrying costs with no use.
bands.lever: Vacancy is the opener.

bands.reading: Habitability case; owner cannot or will not fund repairs.
bands.lever: Repair-cost framing.

bands.reading: Mail bouncing; likely vacant or owner moved.
bands.lever: Skip trace to the new address.

bands.reading: Minor case; corroboration only.
bands.lever: None alone.

factors.name: tenure_basis_lock

bands.reading: Pre-1997 holder or no exception events; likely older owner, little or no mortgage.
bands.lever: Tax-strategy content (1031, installment, DST) and life-stage conversation.

bands.reading: Long hold; substantial embedded gain.
bands.lever: Quarterly nurture.

bands.reading: Mid hold.
bands.lever: Needs another family.

bands.reading: Recent buyer; little basis lock.
bands.lever: Check RECENT_1031_ACQUISITION penalty.

factors.notes: av_rmv_ratio = ROLLM50 / (ROLLLAND + ROLLIMP) on Oregon rolls. Raise the equity factor when no trust deed recorded in the last 10 years.

hard_filters.condition: NOD_RESCISSION after NOD_RECORDED, or Reconveyance closing the only distress event
phone channel only: DNC or litigator flag from licensed vendor

routes.note: owner lead closed; optional REO track

quality_rules: Absentee tier, tenure and equity are never a standalone lead; require at least one HARD_DISTRESS, TAX_LIEN, OWNERSHIP (probate/HECM/DOR) or PHYSICAL event before tier B or above.
Equity uses RMV calibrated by sales ratio or an AVM; never Assessed Value in Measure-50 states.
